claude.note: Tiers are listed lightest first. Every Claude tier runs at xhigh effort, the same as Opus: the claude CLI accepts it for Haiku, Sonnet and Opus, and a lighter model should not also lose effort. Every new task names its tier with --tier; choose the lightest one that does the task as well as the top one.

light.use: mechanical and lookup work: running tests or gates and reporting, reproducing a bug, inventories and summaries, renames and other mechanical edits, gathering facts from given files

standard.use: well-specified, bounded work: small changes with clear done criteria, tests for existing behavior, docs, reviews of small diffs

complex.use: hard or high-risk work: several modules, an unsettled approach, costly or subtle mistakes, a large unfamiliar subsystem, a large or risky review, a failed lighter attempt; every pull-request babysitter
